The '''City of Illian''' is the capital of the [[Illian|nation of the same name]]. 

== Description ==
Illian is a major seaport, and a manufacturing center for fine rugs, textiles, and leather goods.{{ref/book|bwb}}

== History ==
Illian is built on the site of [[Dorelle Caromon]], a city in the nation of [[Eharon]] during the [[Ten Nations]] period between the [[Breaking of the World]] and the [[Trolloc Wars]].{{ref/book|bwb}}
